You had some very high readings at about 15:00. This caused xDrip to resize the vertical scale. After a few hours those readings are no longer on the screen so the vertical scale is resized to fit the newer readings.
Recent versions include the voice command: `clean up excessive high readings` which can resolve this quicker than waiting for 24 hours to pass.
